welcomeBody: Let's take a short tour of the app. All data stays in the project folder on your disk.
welcomeHint: About two minutes. You can stop the tour at any time.
createWaiting: We will continue as soon as a project is open.
projectsBody: A project is a folder with people, events and media. Create a new one here or open an existing folder.
createBody: Press Create and give the project a name. If you already have an AT5 or GEDCOM file, use Import to build the project from it.
personsBody: A person card keeps names, dates, photos, events and relationships. Press Add to enter the first person.
personsAddBody: The card opens here. Enter a name; the other fields can wait.
eventsBody: This tab collects every event in the archive: births, marriages, moves and more.
eventsAddBody: An event ties people to a date and a place. The date can be partial: a year or a month is enough.
mapBody: The map shows where events happened, so you can see the family's geography.
graphBody: The tree is built from one person: view ancestors, descendants or the whole tree.
timelineBody: The timeline lays dated events out in one line, which makes a life story easy to check.
pathBody: Relation shows the path between two people and names their kinship.
searchBody: Search covers people and events. Type a name, a place or part of a title.
chatBody: The assistant answers questions about the archive and the app. It works after a provider is configured in Settings.
helpBody: The guide is always available: short sections for every screen, search, and a way to replay this tour.
finishBody: That covers the main screens. Start with People or open the guide; you can replay the tour from there.
